curation.notes: Magnetic tweezers R-loop assay: a supercoiled 2.04 kbp DNA carrying a single SpCas12f1 target site (biotin/digoxigenin anchor fragments) is held at 0.3-0.4 pN while SpCas12f1-sgRNA (33 nM) forms R-loops, detected as DNA length changes. Combined with cryo-EM (PDB 9i8y) and ensemble cleavage kinetics; the biotin-end bead partner is not stated in the provided text.

evidence.snippet: Time trajectories of the DNA length were recorded at 120 Hz and smoothed with a sliding average to 6 Hz for analysis.
Time trajectories of the DNA length were recorded at 120 Hz and smoothed with a sliding average to 6 Hz for analysis.
Imaging was carried out with a TM1067 CL CCD camera (Pulnix) at 120 Hz.
DNA molecules were bound to 1 μm magnetic beads (MyOne; Invitrogen) and flushed into the flow cell of the setup, allowing the tethering of the digoxigenin-modified DNA end.

handle_sequences.annotations: Anchor fragments to flow cell and magnetic bead were synthesized by PCR using Taq polymerase, plasmid pBluescript II SK, and primers pBlueFor and pBlueRev2 including biotinylated or digoxigenin-modified deoxyuridine triphosphate (dUTP) in the reaction mixtures.

entities.name: 2.04 kbp DNA with single SpCas12f1 target site

evidence.snippet: Next, the plasmid was used to produce a 2.04 kbp PCR fragment using primers CRISPR-SpeI-For and CRISPR-NotI-Rev, by which a SpeI or a NotI restriction site was introduced at either fragment end.

entities.name: Biotin- and digoxigenin-modified anchor fragments (pBluescript II SK)

evidence.snippet: After purification, the modified fragments were cleaved at their centrally located SpeI (for biotin) and NotI (for digoxigenin) sites using the corresponding enzymes.

For measurements with SpCas12f, reconstituted SpCas12f-sgRNA was added in measurement buffer (10 mM Tris–HCl, pH 7.5, 200 mM NaCl, 10 mM MgCl2, 1 mg/ml bovine serum albumine (BSA)) at a concentration of 33 nM.

source.snippet: Our data indicate that SpCas12f1 forms 18 bp R-loops, in which local contacts of the protein to the R-loop stabilize R-loop intermediates.
